title: Nathalie Molina Niño (LEAPFROG author, impact investor) — 'Profits attract predators. Had to stop and take a breath after this line'
summary: Nathalie Molina Niño — impact investor, co-founder of Known, board member, and author of LEAPFROG — pulls a single line from Incorruptible and lets it stand on its own: the moment where Eric names the structural inevitability of predators once a company generates profit.
blockquote:
"Profits attract predators." 

Had to stop and take a breath after this line from Eric Ries in his new book Incorruptible.
attribution_title: Impact investor; co-founder of Known; author of LEAPFROG
